name: Rincón (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Divided horizontally orange over green with a red triangle at the hoist bearing a large white star for the urban zone surrounded by nine small stars for the barrios, and a yellow triangle between them.
history: Rincón is a beach town and municipality on the west coast of Puerto Rico. The flag was created by Evaristo Cardona Moreno and drawn by his son José Luis Cardona Martínez: the red and orange stand for the vitality of its people, the yellow for Christianity, the green for vegetation and hope, and the white for the integrity between the barrios and the urban zone. It was approved by the Municipal Assembly on 28 September 1973, according to Flags of the World.

features.role: large star for the urban zone with nine small stars for the barrios
